title: SUPER-NATURALINSTRUCTIONS: Generalization via Declarative Instructions on 1600+ NLP Tasks

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated as part of a massive cross-task benchmark by measuring the model's instruction-following performance (using Exact Match) on gender-focused coreference resolution datasets, specifically WinoBias and GAP (Gendered Ambiguous Pronouns).
Included as a task category ('Stereotype Detection') within the large-scale multi-task NLP benchmark to assess models' ability to generalize and follow instructions on diverse unseen tasks.
